role: Interpretation half of AnalysisSummaryGenerator: HRV band (personal vs age-adjusted), the 0-100 diagnostic score, headline title/icon, 'What This Means' explanation, probable causes, key findings and trend insight sentences; plus ExplanationCopy (per-band paragraph builders).
types: ExplanationCopy: enum — 'What This Means' paragraph builders per RMSSDCategory
ExplanationCopy.Inputs: struct — preformatted values the builders read
AnalysisSummaryGenerator.RecentAverageRatio: enum (private) — 1.15 excellent reading, 1.1 excellent HRV, 0.95 good HRV against the recent average
AnalysisSummaryGenerator.AverageBand: enum — wellAbove/above/consistent/below/wellBelow, tonight's RMSSD against the recent average
AnalysisSummaryGenerator.Deviation: enum — above/below a reference past a threshold
AnalysisSummaryGenerator.LoadReading: struct — acwr/ctl/atl from the live snapshot or the frozen context, with the ctl-qualified ratio and the very-low-activity test
toplevel: DiagnosticPoints constants: base 50; RMSSD excellent 40/good 30/fair 20/reduced 10/low -10; stress low 20/normal 15/elevated 10/high 0/very high -15; LF/HF optimal 20/parasympathetic 15/moderate 5/sympathetic -10; DFA optimal 20; ANS balance +15/+10/-5/-15. Max raw total 165 and min -40 before clamping to 0...100. RecentAverageRatio (1.15/1.1/0.95) and notableSleepChangePercent (25) name the narrative's ratio cut points. The findings and the trend insight share one band decision per judgement (averageBand, deviation, personalBaselinePercent).

units.does: Maps biologicalSex (.male/.female, else nil) to AgeAdjustedHRV.Sex and returns AgeAdjustedHRV.interpret for tonight's RMSSD, userAge and sex.
HRV band: personalCategory(ratio rmssd/canonicalBaselineRMSSD) when a positive canonical baseline exists, else the age-adjusted population category.

branches.effect: population ageAdjustedInterpretation.category; else personal ratio band

units.does: Bands a ratio to baseline: >=1.15 excellent, >=0.85 good, >=0.70 fair, >=0.60 reduced, else low.
Diagnostic score: 50 + RMSSD band points + stress-index points + LF/HF points + 20 if DFA α1 in [0.75,1.0] + ANS balance points, clamped to 0...100.
Points per RMSSD category: 40/30/20/10/-10.
ANS balance points from pns-sns: >=1.0 → +15, >=0 → +10, >=-1.0 → -5, else -15; 0 when either index missing.
Recovery score 0-100 for the headline: session.scoreBreakdown.compositeScore, else session.recoveryScore×10, else nil.

branches.effect: fall back to recoveryScore*10; nil if that is also nil

units.does: headline score: compositeHeadlineScore, else the generator's lazily computed diagnosticScore (computeDiagnosticScore() run once).

branches.effect: diagnostic score used instead (different scale semantics on the same ScoreVerdict ladder)

units.does: ScoreVerdict for headlineScore.
Headline title: verdict's English word when NarrativeLanguage.isEnglish, else its localized word.
Headline SF Symbol name from the verdict.
'What This Means' paragraph: dispatches on hrvCategory to the matching ExplanationCopy builder with explanationInputs.
Gathers formatted RMSSD, the stress index, LF/HF and DFA α1 as measured (nil when the night produced none), age note, sleep flags, awake minutes, formatted sleep and the sleep context sentence.

branches.effect: no canonical baseline → ' (<age phrase>)' or '' when no age; canonical baseline → '' (age note dropped)

units.does: Population age phrase for the age-adjusted category; nil when the interpretation has no ageContext (no age given).
One sleep sentence: short sleep, else fragmented, else low efficiency (<75%); nil when no sleep or none applies.

branches.effect: nil; else low-efficiency sentence with rounded percent

units.does: True when RMSSD is good the way hrvCategory judges it (isGoodRMSSD) and otherMarkersAreSettled (stress, LF/HF and DFA α1 all measured and none raised).

True only when the stress index, LF/HF and DFA α1 are all present and stress < 200, LF/HF < 2.5 and DFA α1 < 1.2. A missing marker makes it false, so a reading without one never counts as good or excellent.

branches.cond: any of stressIndex, lfHfRatio, dfaAlpha1 is nil

units.does: RMSSD good: >= 0.85×canonical baseline when one exists, else >= 40 ms absolute.

branches.effect: absolute rule rmssd >= 40; else ratio rule

units.does: Top-3 probable causes from CauseDetector over causeContext, converted to ProbableCause.

Builds CauseDetectionContext: RMSSD, stress/LF-HF/DFA (a missing one passed as the resting value 150/1.0/1.0 the rules expect as a number), pNN50 only when measured (measuredPNN50; nil for an estimate), isGoodReading(rmssd:), isExcellentReading (stats.hasData, rmssd > 1.15×avgRMSSD and otherMarkersAreSettled), tags, trend stats, sleep, sleep trend, session and earlier sessions.

branches.effect: isExcellent; the context flag also needs otherMarkersAreSettled
150 passed to the rules (no longer used for good/excellent)
nil passed; the training-load rule then does not fire

units.does: Key findings list: trend/baseline findings, age/band finding (given previous findings), stress, LF/HF, heart rhythm, window quality, beat variation, sleep, sleep trend (with isGoodHRV) and training load findings.
Good HRV for the sleep lines: isGoodRMSSD (>= 0.85× canonical baseline, else >= 40 ms) or, with trend stats, RMSSD >= 0.95× the recent average.
Band of a percent difference from the recent average: > 20 wellAbove, > 10 above, < -20 wellBelow, < -10 below, |pct| < 10 consistent, nil at exactly ±10.
Which side of a reference a difference falls once past the threshold: .above when > threshold, .below when < -threshold, else nil.
Percent difference of rmssd from the 5-night personal baseline (stats.baselineRMSSD); nil when the canonical baseline is present or the personal one is missing or <= 0.

branches.cond: canonical baseline present, or baselineRMSSD nil/<=0

units.does: Trend findings (needs stats): percent vs avgRMSSD sentence, personal 5-night baseline sentence, 7-day trend sentence and resting-HR sentence concatenated.

One sentence on RMSSD vs the recent average by averageBand: wellAbove → the trend card's 'well above your average… read a jump this large alongside how you feel and your recent training' (no 'excellent recovery'), above → good recovery, wellBelow → may be compromised, below → below usual range; consistent or edge → none.
Personal-baseline sentence (only without canonical baseline, via personalBaselinePercent): more than 15% above or below the 5-night baseline.

branches.effect: above → great-shape sentence; below → below sentence; nil → []

units.does: 7-day trend sentence via deviation(trend7Day, beyond: 0): improving when > 0, decline when < 0.

branches.effect: above → improving; below → decline; nil → [] (0 cannot occur since trend7Day is nil unless the verdict moved)

units.does: Resting-HR sentence via deviation(meanHR − avgHR, beyond: 5): elevated when more than 5 bpm above, lower when more than 5 below.

Band finding: when other findings exist, only 'This reading is <age phrase>' (population band, no canonical baseline) or nothing; when none, 'HRV is <band> at X ms' by hrvCategory with optional age suffix.

branches.effect: return age-phrase sentence or [] (when agePhrase nil); else band sentence

units.does: Stress index sentence: >300 high, >150 elevated, >50 normal, else low.
LF/HF sentence: >3.0 high (softened when pNN50 > 25 and RMSSD >= 40), <0.5 low, within [0.8,1.5] usual range, otherwise none. Strong vagal tone needs a measured pNN50 (an estimate counts as 0).

branches.effect: pNN50 treated as 0: not strong vagal tone
'common sleep-stage variation'; else 'above usual resting range — deep breathing…'
usual range sentence; else [] (0.5-0.8 and 1.5-3.0 silent)

units.does: DFA α1 sentence: >1.35 accumulated fatigue; >1.2 fatigue unless strong vagal tone; [0.75,1.0] in reference range; [0.60,0.75) less organized; else none. Strong vagal tone needs a measured pNN50 (an estimate counts as 0).

branches.effect: pNN50 treated as 0: not strong vagal tone

units.does: Window-quality caveat when result.isOrganizedRecovery is false: DFA <0.65 'didn't settle', >1.15 'signs of fatigue', otherwise 'not fully consolidated'; no DFA → 'no deep recovery window'.

branches.effect: nil treated as organized → no caveat
DFA-specific sentences; else 'No deep recovery window' sentence

units.does: pNN50 sentence: none when pNN50 is an estimate; <5 very low variation, >30 strong variation, else none.
Sleep findings (duration + efficiency) when sleep was recorded.
Sleep duration sentence: <300 min → remarkable (HRV > 1.1×avg) / solid (isGoodHRV) / short-sleep-factor; >=420 min with HRV > 1.1×avg → great combo; else none.

branches.effect: solid sentence; else 'Short sleep… likely a major factor in reduced HRV'

units.does: Sleep efficiency sentence: >=92% nearly uninterrupted; <75% with >360 min in bed → low efficiency with awake minutes; else none.
Sleep trend findings when sleep recorded and >=3 trend nights: direction sentence plus tonight-vs-average sentence (percent diff 0 when average is 0).

branches.cond: no sleep, no sleepTrend or nightsAnalyzed < 3

units.does: Direction sentence by trends.trend: declining always; improving only when isGoodHRV; stable only when avg >= 7 h and isGoodHRV; insufficient none.
Tonight-vs-average sentence when |diff| > notableSleepChangePercent (25%): above-average or below-average.

branches.effect: above sentence; else below sentence with average hours

units.does: Training-load finding from loadReading (live snapshot first, else caller's or result's frozen context — the push gate's source): with a ctl-qualified ACR, <0.8 below usual, >1.5 jumped sharply, >1.3 above usual, else none; without one, ctl and atl both under ctlThreshold → very low activity.

branches.cond: loadReading nil (no live snapshot and no context)

units.does: The acute:chronic ratio when present, finite and ctl >= RecoveryScoreConstants.Readiness.ctlThreshold (the qualification TrainingAdviceGate applies); else nil.

branches.cond: acwr nil, not finite, or ctl below ctlThreshold

units.does: True when both ctl and atl are below RecoveryScoreConstants.Readiness.ctlThreshold.
LoadReading from liveLoadSnapshot (acwr/ctl/atl) when the caller captured one, else from trainingContext ?? result.trainingContext (acuteChronicRatio/ctl/atl); nil when neither exists.

branches.cond: no caller or result training context
branches.effect: nil; else reading from the frozen context

units.does: Trend paragraph: 'Record more sessions' without stats; else RMSSD-vs-average, baseline, resting HR, stress and 7-day trend insights joined, plus a 'trends will become more accurate' line when fewer than 7 sessions.
RMSSD vs average insight by averageBand: consistent, wellAbove (the trend card's read-alongside-training sentence, not 'excellent recovery'), above, wellBelow, below; nil band (exactly ±10) → none.
Personal-baseline insight (only without canonical baseline, via personalBaselinePercent): more than 15% below / above.

branches.effect: below → below sentence; above → great-shape sentence; nil → []

units.does: Resting HR insight via deviation(meanHR − avgHR, beyond: 5): elevated or lower.
Stress insight when tonight's stress > 1.3×period average and > 200.

branches.cond: stress or avgStress nil, or stress <= 1.3×avg, or stress <= 200

units.does: 7-day trend insight via deviation(trend7Day, beyond: 0): improving (>0) or decline (<0).
Mid-sentence population age phrase per category.

Low-band paragraph: opening; short sleep → short-sleep explanation only; else reason by a measured stress > 300, a measured LF/HF > 3.0, or generic suppressed-parasympathetic text (also when those markers are missing), plus sleep context.

branches.effect: LF/HF reason; else generic suppressed-parasympathetic reason

units.does: Reduced-band paragraph: short sleep → sentence; fragmented → sentence; else reason by a measured DFA > 1.2, a measured stress > 200 or generic, plus sleep context.

Excellent-band paragraph: good sleep + not fragmented + consolidated → fully ready; short sleep → capacity caveat; not consolidated → not sustained; else the neutral beat-to-beat sentence. No autonomic-balance verdict.

branches.effect: not sustained; else neutral beat-to-beat sentence

units.does: Good-band paragraph: good unfragmented sleep → well-positioned; short sleep → better-sleep sentence; else only the sleep context note (fragmented or low-efficiency sleep, or nothing). No autonomic-balance verdict.

branches.effect: opening + sleepContext (or opening alone when nil)

units.does: Fair-band paragraph: short sleep → opening + short-sleep sentence; else opening + sleep context note. Nothing is read off LF/HF.

branches.effect: opening + sleepContext (or opening alone when nil)

units.does: True when the marker is present and above the threshold; false when it is nil.
Joins the non-nil sentences with a space.
